original.target_description: Section 4.3 dependent-samples t-test comparing pre-service teachers’ judgments of fictitious ninth graders’ interest in problems with versus without a connection to reality, adjusted for perceived task difficulty. Outcome is judgments of students’ interest, not pre-service teachers’ own interest.

n.sample_role: Pre-service teacher participants providing paired judgments; critical-test analytic count not explicitly stated.
n.exclusions: Critical-test exclusions/missingness not documented. Participation count 163 retained only as candidate.

notes: Identity independently checked: article masthead names Johanna Rellensmann and Stanislaw Schukajlow, exact assigned title, DOI 10.1007/s11858-016-0819-3, ZDM Mathematics Education (2017) 49:367–378, published online 6 October 2016. ResearchGate profile uses Johanna Schoenherr, but article itself prints Rellensmann. Supplied source is author-uploaded article text in web-parser segments, with methods and relevant results, not abstract only. No PDF supplied; rendering unavailable. Target mapped by outcome, sample, and p. 7/§4.3, not numerical matching: the paired problem-type comparison of pre-service teachers’ judgments. Section 4.2 is students’ own interest (d=0.30); §4.4 is accuracy relative to zero (d=0.64 and d=0.77), different tests not selected. N candidate: 163 participating pre-service teachers; target test prints t(162), but no explicit test-specific analytic N/exclusions. No N derived from df, no group sum, no effect conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
